decisions.why: We use a cool technical grid stage and 3D tilted interface framing with split numbers to clearly contrast national access rates against regional zero access pockets, differentiating markedly from previous paper-themed center-aligned videos.

wishlist.why: Allowing camera to pan smoothly across the interactive MapLibre choropleth while polygons highlight on hover would showcase spatial distribution.
Highlighting individual rows in the Coverage by geography table as the camera zooms in would clarify regional disparities.
